integrity: The claim is proved by a self-contained combinatorial argument with an independently implemented exhaustive finite cross-check. All cited work is properly attributed; the earlier introduction of the invariant is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only 3-distance mutual visibility on 2D rectangular Cartesian path grids with m,n>=3; no claims for k>3, higher products, thin grids, or alternative visibility rules. Possible unindexed equivalent results and inaccessible full text for one unrestricted-prior-work paper remain bibliographic risks. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Six-point rigidity of three-distance mutual visibility in rectangular grids
